## Role and prompt

Read the spec and ACCEPTANCE.md, review the final implementation and verify recorded tests. Write a concise readiness assessment in docs/REVIEW.md with file references and any discrepancies. Add Windows setup and demo instructions to the project README if missing.

Use docs/SPEC.md as the source of truth. Report files changed, verification and blockers briefly.
